receiver_contract.meaning: Borrow the receiver immutably; method-body analysis cannot reinterpret it.
Borrow the receiver mutably; the caller retains ownership.
Move the receiver into the call without granting a mutable binding.
Move the receiver into the call and grant a mutable method-local binding.

surfaces.old_surface: public bigint annotation, runtime type object, Type::BigInt, transition diagnostics, and quarantine fixtures
surfaces.canonical_contract: int is the only exact source-level integer; explicit fixed-width types own representation boundaries
surfaces.behavior_difference: canonical int retains arbitrary-precision runtime storage while mixed int/bigint conversion branches disappear

surfaces.old_surface: sifr.math.abs_val public intrinsic re-export
surfaces.canonical_contract: sifr.math.fabs(x: float) -> float
surfaces.behavior_difference: none; abs_val is the implementation spelling of the same float operation

surfaces.old_surface: sifr.math.pow_val public intrinsic re-export
surfaces.canonical_contract: sifr.math.pow(x: float, y: float) -> float
surfaces.behavior_difference: none; pow_val remains private implementation detail until the wrapper owns the call

surfaces.old_surface: min_val, max_val, and round_val public intrinsic re-exports
surfaces.canonical_contract: the built-in min, max, and round operations; math-only implementation names stay private
surfaces.behavior_difference: the float intrinsics are not a second public API

surfaces.old_surface: Phase 7 proposed sifr.shutil.move
surfaces.canonical_contract: sifr.shutil.move_file
surfaces.behavior_difference: move is a Sifr and Rust keyword; move_file is the single parse-safe public spelling

surfaces.old_surface: CPython operator.mod spelling
surfaces.canonical_contract: sifr.operator.mod_val
surfaces.behavior_difference: mod is a Rust keyword; mod_val is the single parse-safe public spelling

surfaces.old_surface: Phase 7 proposed re.match and CPython Pattern.match spellings
surfaces.canonical_contract: module functions use search or fullmatch by semantics and Pattern uses is_match
surfaces.behavior_difference: match is a Sifr and Rust keyword; the canonical names state the operation without a parser escape

surfaces.old_surface: random_int public intrinsic re-export
surfaces.canonical_contract: sifr.random.randint(minimum: int, maximum: int) -> Result[int, ValueError]
surfaces.behavior_difference: the canonical wrapper advances and persists module state

surfaces.old_surface: random_float public intrinsic re-export
surfaces.canonical_contract: sifr.random.random() -> float
surfaces.behavior_difference: the canonical wrapper advances and persists module state

surfaces.old_surface: random_uniform public intrinsic re-export
surfaces.canonical_contract: sifr.random.uniform(minimum: float, maximum: float) -> float
surfaces.behavior_difference: the canonical wrapper advances and persists module state

surfaces.old_surface: random_choice audit candidate
surfaces.canonical_contract: sifr.random.choice(items)
surfaces.behavior_difference: random_choice is not a live export; choice is the sole stateful operation

surfaces.old_surface: platform_system, platform_arch, platform_node, platform_release, platform_version, and platform_processor public re-exports
surfaces.canonical_contract: system, machine, node, release, version, and processor
surfaces.behavior_difference: wrappers preserve behavior; intrinsic spellings become private aliases

surfaces.old_surface: time_now and time_format public re-exports
surfaces.canonical_contract: time and strftime; sleep, perf_counter, and monotonic remain canonical distinct operations
surfaces.behavior_difference: time and strftime are wrappers over private intrinsics

surfaces.old_surface: get_args, sys_exit, sys_version, sys_platform, and sys_maxsize public re-exports
surfaces.canonical_contract: argv, exit, version, platform, and maxsize
surfaces.behavior_difference: wrappers preserve behavior; intrinsic spellings become private aliases

surfaces.old_surface: env_get, env_set, env_unset, env_keys, env_values, and env_items public re-exports
surfaces.canonical_contract: getenv_opt, getenv, setenv, unsetenv, keys, values, and items
surfaces.behavior_difference: getenv keeps an explicit typed default while getenv_opt returns Option[str]

surfaces.old_surface: sifr.datetime.utc()
surfaces.canonical_contract: sifr.datetime.UTC()
surfaces.behavior_difference: none; both construct the zero-offset timezone

surfaces.old_surface: re_match, re_find, re_replace, re_findall, re_split, their flag variants, and index helpers
surfaces.canonical_contract: search, sub, findall, split, finditer, compile, and fullmatch; Pattern.is_match is the keyword-safe method spelling
surfaces.behavior_difference: approved behavior is retained through the canonical operations before direct helpers disappear

surfaces.old_surface: json_loads
surfaces.canonical_contract: loads(s: str) -> Result[JsonValue, JSONDecodeError]
surfaces.behavior_difference: none

surfaces.old_surface: json_dumps and json_dumps_value, json_dumps_value_exact, json_dumps_value_web, and json_dumps_value_string_ints
surfaces.canonical_contract: dumps, dumps_exact, dumps_web, and dumps_string_ints
surfaces.behavior_difference: the canonical family must gain every approved json_dumps input type before the broader aliases are removed

surfaces.old_surface: toml_loads
surfaces.canonical_contract: sifr.tomllib.loads(text: str) -> Result[TomlValue, TOMLDecodeError]
surfaces.behavior_difference: none

surfaces.old_surface: base64_encode, base64_decode, their bytes and options variants, and unrenamed private crypto imports
surfaces.canonical_contract: b64encode, b64decode, standard_b64encode, standard_b64decode, encodebytes, decodebytes, and explicitly typed bytes variants
surfaces.behavior_difference: text and bytes signatures remain distinct where their input and output types differ; same-signature base64_* aliases disappear

surfaces.old_surface: b64encode text and b64encode_bytes binary signatures
surfaces.canonical_contract: the typed text and bytes operations remain separately named because they have different input and output types
surfaces.behavior_difference: text operations encode or decode text; bytes operations preserve binary data

surfaces.old_surface: fnmatch_filter
surfaces.canonical_contract: sifr.fnmatch.filter(names: list[str], pattern: str) -> list[str]
surfaces.behavior_difference: none

surfaces.old_surface: html_escape and html_unescape public intrinsic re-exports
surfaces.canonical_contract: escape and unescape
surfaces.behavior_difference: escape owns the public quote option; intrinsics stay private

surfaces.old_surface: calendar_isleap, calendar_weekday, and calendar_monthrange public intrinsic re-exports
surfaces.canonical_contract: isleap, weekday, and monthrange
surfaces.behavior_difference: none; implementation names stay private

surfaces.old_surface: parse_url and build_url
surfaces.canonical_contract: parse and build
surfaces.behavior_difference: none

surfaces.old_surface: sifr.bytes wrappers for encode, decode, hex, integer-list construction, sized construction, byte search, and prefix tests
surfaces.canonical_contract: first-class bytes methods and constructors; any non-method helper must have one non-transition owner
surfaces.behavior_difference: approved search and prefix behavior moves to first-class bytes before the transition module disappears

surfaces.old_surface: string one-shot hash helpers, HashObject.update(str), hashlib.new(str data), and string object constructors
surfaces.canonical_contract: bytes-native hash constructors and update; text callers encode explicitly
surfaces.behavior_difference: digest and hexdigest remain distinct outputs; implicit UTF-8 conversion disappears

surfaces.old_surface: HashObject.digest and HashObject.hexdigest
surfaces.canonical_contract: digest returns bytes and hexdigest returns hexadecimal text
surfaces.behavior_difference: the return types and semantics differ

surfaces.old_surface: new_set, set_from_list, set_add, set_contains, set_remove, set_len, set_union, and set_intersection
surfaces.canonical_contract: first-class generic set[T] constructors, methods, and operators
surfaces.behavior_difference: canonical sets are generic set values rather than copied list[int] values

surfaces.old_surface: heapify_copy, heappush_copy, heappop_val, and heappop_rest
surfaces.canonical_contract: mutating heapify, heappush, heappop, heapreplace, and heappushpop
surfaces.behavior_difference: canonical operations mutate their explicit mut receiver and return only the operation result

surfaces.old_surface: insort_left_copy and insort_right_copy
surfaces.canonical_contract: mutating insort_left and insort_right
surfaces.behavior_difference: canonical operations mutate their explicit mut receiver and return None

surfaces.old_surface: any unrenamed _sifr import that compiled public-module metadata exposes as a public implementation-name export
surfaces.canonical_contract: public modules expose only documented wrappers or explicitly approved distinct operations
surfaces.behavior_difference: private aliases remain callable only inside their declaring public module

surfaces.old_surface: method-body mutability inference plus own self to shared-borrow and own mut self to mutable-borrow mappings
surfaces.canonical_contract: the four receiver spellings map directly to the receiver_contract table in this inventory
surfaces.behavior_difference: owned forms consume the receiver; omitted mutability cannot be inferred from the body

surfaces.old_surface: [source].roots, multiple roots, package sifr/ default, and driver ./ default
surfaces.canonical_contract: optional [source].root with one relative path and src/ as the sole default
surfaces.behavior_difference: multi-root ambiguity and schema selection disappear

surfaces.old_surface: [exports].modules and [[bin]] manifest readers plus manifest-derived ImportRoot values
surfaces.canonical_contract: package name determines the ImportRoot; unsupported manifest fields use the ordinary schema diagnostic
surfaces.behavior_difference: manifest-level module and binary declarations are rejected

surfaces.old_surface: <sysroot>/sifr binary and flat-layout receipt acceptance
surfaces.canonical_contract: <sysroot>/bin/sifr with one strict receipt relationship
surfaces.behavior_difference: old flat receipts fail through the unmanaged-install diagnostic

surfaces.old_surface: SIFR-WORKSPACE-0101 through SIFR-WORKSPACE-0104
surfaces.canonical_contract: SIFR-IMPORT-0002, SIFR-IMPORT-0005, SIFR-IMPORT-0006, and SIFR-IMPORT-0007
surfaces.behavior_difference: span-less root diagnostics use <unknown> while retaining resolution notes

surfaces.old_surface: old Sifr stdlib module replacement tables and migration-only messages
surfaces.canonical_contract: normal unsupported import or member diagnostics without an abandoned-name recognizer
surfaces.behavior_difference: no targeted migration suggestion remains

surfaces.old_surface: special recognition for abandoned Rust interop decorator keys
surfaces.canonical_contract: ordinary canonical decorator-key validation
surfaces.behavior_difference: old keys receive the generic unsupported-key diagnostic

surfaces.old_surface: diagnostic_legacy_display and legacy_diagnostic_display
surfaces.canonical_contract: tests use the production diagnostic renderer
surfaces.behavior_difference: test rendering no longer collapses the structured diagnostic shape

surfaces.old_surface: __compat_sifr_sync_ and __compat_sifr_concurrent_ prefix stripping
surfaces.canonical_contract: canonical task, sync, and blocking names reach lowering unchanged
surfaces.behavior_difference: hidden aliases are no longer accepted

surfaces.old_surface: profile schema version 1 output and required legacy_facade configuration
surfaces.canonical_contract: profile schema version 2 with selected_areas, toolchain_steps, and guardrail_steps
surfaces.behavior_difference: one selected-area execution plan replaces duplicate facade-derived plans

surfaces.old_surface: --hardening-summary producers and legacy summary-line report parsers
surfaces.canonical_contract: area runners emit and report consumers read one structured result JSON shape
surfaces.behavior_difference: text summary parsing disappears

surfaces.old_surface: # expect-stdout fixture directives and extract_expect_stdout
surfaces.canonical_contract: Sifr assert statements are the only pass-fixture runtime expectation model
surfaces.behavior_difference: the harness no longer parses expected stdout from comments

surfaces.old_surface: lower-layer entrypoints that construct DiskSourceProvider and paired foo/foo_with_provider APIs
surfaces.canonical_contract: one CLI or session composition root constructs disk access; lower layers receive a provider or captured session
surfaces.behavior_difference: all source reads and probes participate in dependency recording

surfaces.old_surface: PackageSourceMap::resolve_import Option-returning wrapper
surfaces.canonical_contract: resolve_import_result with unresolved, ambiguous, access, and fatal variants
surfaces.behavior_difference: callers must preserve the structured resolution outcome

surfaces.old_surface: Type::rust_type, Type::rust_type_for_struct_field, and RustType::Named string fallbacks
surfaces.canonical_contract: sifr_type_to_rust_type and structured RustType nodes cover every supported type
surfaces.behavior_difference: unsupported types produce a structured compiler error rather than a string or panic fallback

surfaces.old_surface: DLPack legacy and versioned capsule negotiation
surfaces.canonical_contract: retain the protocol-required capsule forms and one-shot ownership rules
surfaces.behavior_difference: external protocol compatibility is not a Sifr source compatibility path

surfaces.old_surface: UTF-16 default when an LSP client omits positionEncodings
surfaces.canonical_contract: retain the LSP protocol default and negotiate explicit supported encodings
surfaces.behavior_difference: the default is required by the external LSP contract

surfaces.old_surface: Cargo metadata normalization and dependency-edge handling
surfaces.canonical_contract: retain normalization required by supported Cargo metadata output
surfaces.behavior_difference: this adapts an external tool format

surfaces.old_surface: Cargo semantic-version resolution
surfaces.canonical_contract: retain semantic-version matching for Cargo dependencies
surfaces.behavior_difference: this implements an external package contract

surfaces.old_surface: IPC protocol-version negotiation inside the supported range
surfaces.canonical_contract: retain negotiated overlap for documented IPC peers
surfaces.behavior_difference: negotiation is the current protocol contract

surfaces.old_surface: operating-system and architecture portability branches
surfaces.canonical_contract: retain supported-host implementations selected by target
surfaces.behavior_difference: target portability is not old Sifr source behavior

surfaces.old_surface: cancellation hooks that preserve cleanup and task termination
surfaces.canonical_contract: retain structured cancellation cleanup
surfaces.behavior_difference: cleanup is current runtime correctness, not compatibility

surfaces.old_surface: documented configuration defaults when values are absent
surfaces.canonical_contract: retain each current typed default
surfaces.behavior_difference: absence defaults are product behavior, not old-schema readers

surfaces.old_surface: translation and locale fallback chains
surfaces.canonical_contract: retain documented locale lookup order and missing-translation behavior
surfaces.behavior_difference: fallback is the current i18n product contract

surfaces.old_surface: compatibility code inside vendored dependencies
surfaces.canonical_contract: exclude vendored code from Sifr-owned compatibility scans
surfaces.behavior_difference: Sifr does not own the dependency contract

surfaces.old_surface: documented external file-format and protocol versions
surfaces.canonical_contract: retain versions that each public format contract declares supported
surfaces.behavior_difference: format interoperability is not Sifr source compatibility

surfaces.old_surface: Phase 40 legacy-index bootstrap evidence and command options
surfaces.canonical_contract: retain the opaque current release-channel bootstrap asset and its attested digest/size inputs
surfaces.behavior_difference: legacy names the governed bootstrap input, not a compatibility reader

surfaces.old_surface: RuleStatus::Deprecated
surfaces.canonical_contract: retain deprecated as current lint-rule lifecycle metadata
surfaces.behavior_difference: the state describes rule lifecycle and does not accept old source syntax
